title: PredictionEvent v1
description: Scoring result produced by Structured Streaming for each valid transaction. Written to NoSQL (collection predictions; also to alerts when alert_triggered = true) and optionally to topic fraud.predictions.v1. Owner: Streaming & Serving Lead. Status: W1 DRAFT, to be finalized together with the output schema in W3.

transaction_id.description: Same as the TransactionEvent transaction_id. Idempotency key of the sink (MongoDB _id).

event_time.description: Copied from the input event, for queries by transaction time.

scored_at.description: Time the streaming app finished scoring (wall clock, UTC).

fraud_score.description: Risk score returned by the model, in [0,1]. NOT assumed to be a calibrated probability.

risk_level.description: Level derived from fraud_score using configured thresholds: HIGH >= t_high, MEDIUM >= t_medium, otherwise LOW. Thresholds to be finalized by Data & ML Evaluation in W3.

alert_triggered.description: true if fraud_score >= alert_threshold (default = t_medium, i.e. both MEDIUM and HIGH raise alerts).

alert_threshold.description: Threshold used at scoring time (stored for reproducibility and explanation).

model_version.description: Model artifact version (e.g. 'baseline_v1', 'rf_v2'). Provided by the Batch & ML Lead in W3-W4.

transaction_type.description: Denormalized from the input so the dashboard can filter/group without joins.

source_account.description: Denormalized from the input (supports alert lookup by account).

latency_ms.description: scored_at - produced_at (ms) if the input has produced_at; null if it cannot be measured.
